primary.title: Here's how to invest your retirement corpus to keep income steady but still earn from your money
primary.summary: Retirement planning requires a thorough analysis of goals, financial status, and lifestyle aspirations. It's crucial to prepare for emergencies while balancing risk in your portfolio, gradually shifting from equities to safer options as you age.
